answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 37221 Country: India Title: Now a days, the bathroom are combined or combo with the toiletng Question: Now a days, the bathroom are combined or combo with the toilet. As we perform wudhu in the bathroom for the salah. Is my wudhu ok, if I do it in the combo bathroom? Please reply. Answer ID: 37221 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 443/443/M=1433) Your wudhu shall be valid but take care that body or clothes are not smeared by the impure splashes. Make wudhu carefully. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
